canonical_project: Quantum Switch Tamasuk DMM-A data center / SPARK campus
notes: QST announced Saudi data-center capacity in 2022, including sites at King Salman Energy Park (SPARK), which is described in press coverage as outside Abqaiq/Buqayq. Project-finance coverage identified the first site as a 7.5 MW data center intended to reach operations in March 2022. DatacenterMap lists DMM-A as an operational carrier-neutral QST facility at SPARK. Public sources differ on whether reported 60 MW refers to aggregate program capacity rather than this first facility, so capacity_mw uses the financing-specific 7.5 MW figure.
